chunks: And if the dwellers of the Wood were indeed wrongdoers.

key_terms.أَصْحَابُ الْأَيْكَةِ: The dwellers of the Wood (people of Midian)

ai.seo_question: Who were the Ashab al-Aykah and what was their sin?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the specific injustice of the Midianites, who not only rejected Prophet Shu'ayb but also engaged in commercial fraud and idolizing a specific tree, thereby compounding their polytheism with social tyranny. This narrative serves as a precursor to the ultimate destruction by divine fire, illustrating how collective transgression against both divine and social laws invites severe retribution.
